jobs.title: Video Editor and Motion Design Intern (H1/2027)
jobs.description: About Quandela Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 Description of the Team/Project You will join Quandela’s Corporate Communications team, helping bring quantum computing to life through video and motion design. Working with our communications and design colleagues, technical experts and external production partners, you will help develop our in-house post-production capabilities. You will turn existing footage, internally captured content and professionally filmed material into videos for LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, X and our website. Projects will range from short social clips to interviews, masterclasses, product explainers, and animated use cases. Your Key Responsibilities Edit videos from raw footage through to final delivery, including footage selection, storytelling, pacing, basic colour correction and audio adjustments. Create motion graphics, animated titles and visual explainers that make complex technologies and applications easier to understand. Repurpose longer videos into short clips, adapting formats, pacing and subtitles to each platform. Collaborate with the team on briefs, storyboards and visual ideas, ensuring consistency with Quandela’s brand. Incorporate feedback from communications colleagues and technical experts to ensure content is clear and scientifically accurate. Help organise footage, project files and reusable templates to make future production more efficient. Requirements Education & Background Currently enrolled in a programme in audiovisual production, video editing, motion design, animation

You ll shape Bitpanda s newest business lines, using AI to go from idea to working prototypes in hours and to testing them with real customers within days. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Learn more at WRITER.com . 📐 About the role Design engineers sit at the intersection of design and engineering. As a design engineer at WRITER, you'll own the Writer Design System (WDS) — how it's built, how it's maintained, and how both humans and AI agents use it to ship product. This role matters more now than ever. AI coding agents write more of our production code, and they ship whatever they find. You'll make sure WRITER's core UI library is complete and trustworthy enough to build on, working closely with the designers, PMs, and engineers who rely on it every day. You'll help shape the surfaces that define how our product feels to use, and help set the standard and process for how the EPD org ships product. jobs.description: Über BeginnerBudget Wir sind ein junges Startup aus Hamburg und suchen kreative Unterstützung bei der Gestaltung unserer Werbeanzeigen für Instagram und Facebook. Du hast ein gutes Auge für Design, arbeitest gerne mit Canva und nutzt KI als kreatives Werkzeug? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Die Stelle umfasst 20–30 Stunden pro Monat und ist 100 % remote . Deine Aufgaben Du erstellst statische Bildgrafiken für unsere Meta Ads auf Instagram und Facebook. Du entwickelst unterschiedliche Gestaltungsvarianten, damit wir verschiedene Motive und Botschaften testen können. Du arbeitest mit Canva und nutzt ChatGPT sowie weitere KI-Tools für Ideen und die Umsetzung. Du bringst eigene Gestaltungsideen ein und denkst mit: Was fällt auf, vermittelt die Botschaft klar und spricht unsere Zielgruppe an? Du setzt Feedback um und entwickelst bestehende Grafiken weiter. Das bringst du mit Du studierst Grafikdesign, Kommunikationsdesign, Mediendesign oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen mit Social-Media-Grafiken gesammelt, idealerweise auch mit Werbeanzeigen. Du kannst sicher mit Canva umgehen und hast Erfahrung mit ChatGPT oder anderen KI-Tools. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Layout, Typografie und Bildsprache sowie ein erstes Verständnis dafür, worauf es bei Meta Ads ankommt. Du arbeitest zuverlässig und selbstständig, stellst Fragen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben. Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit und teilst deine Ideen. Das bieten wir dir 100 % Homeoffice arbeiten. Einen überschaubaren Umfang von 20–30 Stunden pro Monat, gut neben dem Studium. Raum für eigene Ideen und die Möglichkeit, unsere Werbegrafiken mitzugestalten. Praktische Erfahrung im Grafikdesign für digitale Werbung und im Einsatz von KI-Tools. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: NetBox Labs seeks a Senior Product Designer to help shape the next generation of our platform. We are building products on top of the NetBox data model that help network teams put their data to work, from interactive maps of their network, to compliance on network intended design, to analytics and AI-driven workflows. This role will own design across these applications and how they connect to each other. You will partner with product managers and engineers on day-to-day delivery, and with design leadership on building a design culture and scaling how design works across the company. Who you are Curiosity drives you. You want to understand how networks actually run and why operators work the way they do. You love rolling up your sleeves and are as happy sketching a flow, building a prototype or sitting in on a customer call. You are energized by complex technical landscapes, where dense data, expert users and messy real-world systems bring out your best work. You have a sharp eye for great design, care about craft and clarity and can explain why something works and how to make it better. Responsibilities Own end-to-end design for platform applications such as Analytics, Visual Explorer, Validation, orAI-driven workflows that customers use directly in the product. Design how these applications interact with each other, NetBox, and our observability products. Turn complex data sets, visualizations, and workflows into clear, usable interfaces for network engineers and architects. Plan and run user research, both qualitative and quantitative, and bring customer insight back to product and engineering teams. Prototype ideas quickly, whether with AI tools, in code, or in Figma, to test concepts with users and engineers. Design in the open. Share work early, invite critique, and keep stakeholders aligned. jobs.title: Hydrus - Session Director - Spanish (Argentina) - V2
jobs.description: About the Project Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. The recordings produced help build natural, everyday-sounding synthesized voices for conversational AI products — voices that sound like real people talking, not scripted performances. As Session Director, you'll lead live recording sessions with Voice Contributors, guiding them through scripted scenarios to produce natural, conversational-quality audio. This hands-on role blends creative direction, coaching, and technical audio judgment — making scripted material sound authentic and unscripted, rather than recited, while keeping sessions moving at a natural pace. What You'll Do Direct voice performers through scripted scenarios, coaching for natural, conversational delivery rather than verbatim recitation. Build quick scene context for performers (who, where, why) and improvise to fill narrative or dialogue gaps live, keeping sessions flowing naturally. Adapt scripted wording for natural phrasing and regional/dialect authenticity as needed. Monitor and correct technical audio quality in real time: mic technique, pacing, clarity, and background noise. Manage session pacing to meet recording targets without sacrificing performance quality, and maintain organized notes on adjustments and retakes. Create a supportive, low-pressure environment for performers, including those with limited prior voice experience. What We're Looking For Required Native fluency in the required language (with specific dialect), with a strong ear for natural, colloquial phrasing. Experience directing, coaching, or producing voice or audio talent (e.g., voice direction, casting direction, audio/podcast production, dubbing/ADR, or theater direction). Demonstrated ability to give clear, specific, actionable performance direction. Strong working knowledge of basic recording/mic technique (proximity, plosives, room noise, levels). jobs.description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. About the Role As a Mechanical Engineer – Design & Simulation, you’ll perform engineering analysis and simulation work across Focused Energy projects, helping design and validate complex mechanical systems before hardware is committed. You’ll provide the analytical confidence needed to make sound design decisions across structural, thermal, dynamic, and fluid-system performance. Working closely with senior mechanical engineers, systems engineers, project teams, and other engineering disciplines, you’ll use modelling and simulation to identify design risks early, recommend mitigations, and ensure mechanical designs are technically sound, manufacturable, safe, and ready for integration. Your work will contribute to systems including vacuum chambers, laser integration, diagnostic structures, and facility infrastructure. What You’ll Do Perform structural, mechanical, and thermal analysis using FEA tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL, or equivalent. Carry out fluid-system analysis and thermal modelling to support mechanical design decisions. Assess vibration, stability, and dynamic behaviour of mechanical assemblies and identify potential design risks. Validate simulation outputs against design requirements, engineering standards, and expected operating conditions. This role has to straddle both — delivering quality and coherence in what exists today while driving the vision for where things go. This is not a management role, but it's a leadership role in the fullest sense. Their influence is felt company-wide — in the product, in the culture, and in who we hire. jobs.title: Vacature: Stagiair Illustrator / Designer
jobs.description: Bigfish is op zoek naar jou! Een enthousiaste stagiair Illustratie/design. Wil jij meewerken aan het ontwikkelen van illustraties en visuele concepten? Als stagiair bij Bigfish ben je echt onderdeel van het team en kun je waardevolle ervaring opdoen in de commerciële sector. Let op: deze stage is uitsluitend bedoeld voor studenten die tijdens de stageperiode staan ingeschreven aan een mbo- of hbo-opleiding. Sollicitaties van afgestudeerden kunnen we helaas niet in behandeling nemen. Taken Wat ga je doen? Ondersteunen bij het maken van illustraties, (interactieve) infographics en storyboards voor animatieprojecten. Samenwerken in een team om ideeën visueel vorm te geven. Je leert hoe je ruwe concepten kunt omzetten in aantrekkelijke visuele designs. Je gaat ervaring opdoen in de commerciële sector en leert communiceren in een ervaren team. Je mag meewerken aan projecten voor verschillende nationale en internationale merken. Vereisten Wat breng je mee? Je volgt een relevante mbo- of hbo- opleiding in de richting van illustratie, grafisch ontwerp of een vergelijkbare creatieve studie. Je hebt een divers portfolio met verschillende illustratiestijlen en visuele uitingen die relevant zijn voor de commerciële markt. Je bent leergierig, creatief en kunt goed samenwerken in een team. Je hebt affiniteit met design en oog voor detail. Basiskennis van design software zoals Adobe Illustrator en Photoshop. Je bent beschikbaar voor een stageperiode van minimaal 4 maanden. Benefits Wat bieden wij? Een leerzame en inspirerende stageplek met een dynamisch team. De kans om werkervaring op te doen bij een van de marktleiders op het gebied van animatie. Een informele werksfeer waarin je je creatieve ideeën kunt uitwerken en jouw ontwikkeling centraal staat. Begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. Een goede stagevergoeding Heb je interesse?
